Aria Lopez: Heads-up 1 026 roadmap sync: sales pushed back asking for quantization recommendations in MVP. I'm proposing a compromise: keep runtime MVP focused on adaptive batching + prefix caching + eval-triggered alerts, but include an "Alpha Quant Advisor" as a separate non-runtime deliverable that runs offline on sampled corpora and returns a small set of human-reviewed recommendations.

Noah Kim: Curious why keep quant out of runtime? Is it purely infra size or also risk to output quality?

Rashmi Gupta: Both. Automated quant recs require sample collection, round-trip evals, and a validation pipeline to catch regressions. If we surface bad recommendations we own the fallout. Offline advisor mitigates risk: produce recommendations with confidence bands and a clear "experimental" label.

Tom Becker: For MVP pilots we can ship advisor as a gated offering: it runs weekly, produces a pdf + recommended config, and a short rubric for when to accept. No auto-deploy to prod. That should reduce implementation cost while still giving customers something.

Lucy Park: Acceptance criteria we should agree on: econ: >=12% median token-cost reduction on pilot routes after enabling batching; reliability: p95 user latency <= baseline +12%; alerts: seeded regression precision >=85% and false positive rate <=8%. For the Alpha Quant Advisor: recommendations precision >=70% on seeded checks and clear caveats.

Aria Lopez: Good. Also add an operational safety gate: for any route with regulatory tag "restricted" we do NOT enable batching by default and require customer opt-in. Sales mentioned some regulated pilot tenants.

sales-bot: Note from Sales: Pilot customers (MedScribe, LedgerAI) flagged regulatory constraints. Documented in CRM ticket #CL-2931.

Noah Kim: Implementation notes from runtime: adaptive batching + prefix KV cache needs per-route feature flags and a lightweight admission-control policy. We'll instrument token-cost delta per-request to correlate econ impact. Advisor pipeline will be a separate job: sample requests, run quantized model offline, compute eval deltas, output ranked suggestions.

Rashmi Gupta: Advisor output format idea: 1) one-line verdict (safe / caution / not recommended), 2) recommended quant config (bits & per-layer), 3) confidence score, 4) examples of changed outputs and suggested eval prompts. This keeps expectations clear.

Tom Becker: Launch gates checklist draft: 1) Bench econ & latency on 4 representative prompt sets, 2) Alerting seeded test suite passes precision/FPR thresholds, 3) Per-route UI toggle + rollback playbook, 4) Advisor job runs end-to-end and produces PDF for at least one pilot, 5) Customer comms & opt-in for restricted tenants.

Lucy Park: Add business rule: monitor first 72 hours of a pilot route; if econ improvement <8% OR user-observed p95 latency increase >10%, auto-disable batching for that route and page owners. Also log a causal bucket for follow-up.

Aria Lopez: Timeline proposal: infra spike (Noah/Rashmi) this week, advisor prototype (Tom) next week, acceptance checklist (Lucy) by Wed, customer comms draft (Aria) by Thu. Target pilot rollout in 12 days.

Noah Kim: I'll post a short admission-control config seed tomorrow: max_wait_ms=25, min_batch_size=3, prefer_short_latency=true. Will add telemetry tags for advisor sampling.

Rashmi Gupta: I'll build a small seeded-eval harness for advisor to estimate recommendation precision. Need two seeded regressions per pilot to validate alerting.

Tom Becker: I'll wire advisor outputs to a private S3 bucket and a small review workflow. No automation to apply suggestions to runtime.

sales-bot: Sales note: Mark pilot as "Advisor included" in CRM for MedScribe & LedgerAI.

Aria Lopez: Decision: runtime MVP = adaptive batching + prefix KV cache + eval-triggered alerts; Alpha Quant Advisor = separate offline deliverable (no auto-apply). Action owners above. Confirming pilot timeline ~12 days. :checkered_flag:
